rules.safety: ST serialized read at ready committed safe point. Native validates full world ID and explicit locked/active task state before GetCounters; every failure leaves all caller output unchanged. No allocation, step, flush, trim, draw or mutation.
rules.capacityLedger: Exact pinned b3GetWorldByteCount ledger, including embedded tree sizeof terms. Not a complete malloc ledger. Sum of every row must equal GetCounters.byteCount. No residual, unknown-as-zero or partial success.
rules.integers: Checked uint64 arithmetic; core int-sized intermediate groups are preflighted before core GetCounters. Overflow or inconsistent accounting returns non-OK.
rules.globals: b3GetByteCount requested-size accounting and actual native air_b3_bridge_memory(0) are separate scopes. Never add them to worldLedger as a total.
rules.stepIndex: Native completed-step identity only, not an epoch of every allocation/mutation. Binding revision/generation are separate labels.
rules.workload: b3World_GetMaxCapacity is a step-sampled historical workload maximum, not allocation capacity, a budget or an acceptance threshold.
rules.workerArena: Backing capacity read independently from taskContexts[].arena.capacity; excluded from worldLedger, distinct from Counters.arenaCapacity peakDemand.
rules.mesh: Successful cook/completed destroy counts are module-wide call counters including rollback. Per-resource leases/borrows are separate existing backend snapshots, not a module-wide census.
rules.afterClose: Unavailable through this live-world backend method. No retained/replacement factory, module or new host is introduced.
